svg.aria-label: K8s AI Troubleshooting Agent on Huawei Cloud CCE — high-level design
svg.text: K8s AI Troubleshooting Agent on Huawei Cloud — High-Level Design (HLD)
Claude API (Opus 5.5) · CCE cluster · one VPC · in-cluster agent with a human approval gate
tools: read always · write only after operator approval
Claude API (API key in a Secret)
loop: unresolved or rejected → new plan
every acronym used in this diagram
Ingress: operator → VPN → private ELB (or port-forward) → UI · Egress: agent → SNAT → EIP → api.anthropic.com · CI: GitHub Actions → SWR
Not shown: CFW · LTS logs · AOM metrics · NetworkPolicy
